mechanism: Amphotericin B causes significant nephrotoxicity and electrolyte disturbances (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) which impair citalopram metabolism and increase QT prolongation risk; additive cardiac effects through multiple pathways.
action: Monitor ECG, electrolytes (especially potassium and magnesium), renal function closely; consider alternative antifungal if possible; maintain citalopram at lowest effective dose; correct electrolyte abnormalities aggressively.
